question: By what increment must the measure be increased in the maiden from the twenty-eighth part?
premises: The starting point is the twenty-eighth part.
The increase is by a half measure.
inference: In the maiden one should increase it by a half measure from the twenty-eighth part.
uncertainties: The technical context of kanyāyāṃ is uncertain.
plain_english: And in the maiden, from the twenty-eighth part, by an increase of a half measure.
